summary: This is a configuration file that defines a local AI model setup. It specifies a single Ollama-based language model (Llama 3.1 with 8 billion parameters) running on the local machine, configured to handle both chat and editing tasks through a local API endpoint.

explanations.3: schema: v1 indicates this config file follows version 1 of the expected format structure, so the system knows how to parse it correctly.
explanations.6: provider: ollama means we're using Ollama as the service that will run and manage the AI model, rather than a cloud service.
explanations.8: apiBase specifies the network address and port where the Ollama service is listening for requests — 127.0.0.1 means 'this local machine' and 11434 is the standard port Ollama uses.
explanations.9: roles defines which types of tasks this model is capable of handling; chat is conversation, and edit means it can modify or rewrite text.
